consents: One unchecked checkbox per configured consent, labelled with its text; a group without active options for the current type is not shown.

captcha.live: Google reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget rendered with the site key from GET /api/form-config
captcha.test: checkbox labelled 'I am not a robot (test mode)'; when checked the token is 'test-pass'

errors: Each field error is shown in an element with role 'alert' that the field references with aria-describedby, and the field gets aria-invalid='true'.
Errors without a field (rate limit, storage failure, verification unavailable, duplicate email message) are shown in one role 'alert' element above the submit button.
The frontend checks required fields, email format and mandatory consents before sending (NFR-03) and shows the backend's field errors next to the same fields.

Field error texts: REQUIRED 'This field is required.', INVALID_EMAIL 'Enter a valid email address.', CONSENT_REQUIRED 'This consent is required.', CAPTCHA_FAILED 'Please confirm that you are not a robot.'
